notes: Replaced the blank native update prompt with a themed, movable progress window that shows download status and install readiness.
Interrupted protected downloads now resume, and verified completed packages are reused after an app restart.
Signed-out players are directed to sign in before protected update downloads begin.
The packaged Windows release passed responsive UI, updater, hosted voice, state-preservation, and recovery verification.
The installer remains an unsigned Windows alpha; its RSA-signed manifest, sequence, size, and SHA-256 protect update delivery.
